conclusions: Four empty banks have <2 B/I admission, so no optimizable sample was published; own coarse fallback remains scored separately.
Nonempty banks lacking a <=5cm proposal cannot be fixed by a selector over that exact bank. This does not prove no feasible <=5cm pose exists.
Nominal-reference feasibility separates hard-guard contradiction from absence of sampled/optimized near-reference candidates; a feasible reference can still lose the noisy semantic objective.

Rank6 is local sensitivity, not unbiased semantic correspondence or correct W/D/physical-depth evidence. Partial-revoked tangent identity, O/U uncertainty and fixed noisy coordinates remain information/model issues.

All reference positions are annotation-derived with unconfirmed signed axes/registration; no independent physical metrology is asserted. No proposed runtime routing or parameter choice uses reference errors.
